published_basis.author: Stefan Szeider
published_basis.paper: Minimal unsatisfiable formulas with bounded clause-variable difference are fixed-parameter tractable
published_basis.theorem_used: SAT for maximum deficiency k is decidable in O(2^k n^3); maximum deficiency is polynomially computable by graph matching; SAT/UNSAT output can be certified by an assignment or regular-resolution refutation.

R44BC-MAXDEF.result: If delta*(F)<=floor(log2 N), Szeider's exact algorithm is a uniform polynomial terminal gate with O(N^4) charged time under original-input accounting.
R44BC-MAXDEF.ceiling: delta*>log N is NO_PROGRESS, not hardness or UNSAT.

R44BD.missing_operator: Given delta*-critical G with children G0,G1 of rank <=k-1, construct one exact SAT-OR merged state M with delta*(M)<=k-1, polynomial work/state/certificate lifting, and closure under next normalization.
R44BD.effect_if_proved: Would yield polynomially many polynomial macrosteps and hence P=NP.

R44BE.result: For disjoint-copy selector guarding with positive child maxdefs a,b, delta*(M)=a+b-1 exactly. Thus equal children of rank k-1 rebound to 2k-3 and fail R44BD M2 for k>=3.
R44BE.scope: Barrier only for selector-guarded merge family; k=2 special layer not refuted.

R44BF.result: Private forced padding C_i -> (C_i OR y_i) AND (not y_i) preserves maximum deficiency exactly for every CNF.
R44BF.effect: Fresh private forced variables cannot repay selector branch deficiency debt.

current_question: Find or refute one shared/nonlocal exact OR-merge gadget satisfying R44BD M1-M6. Do not return to selector reification, ordinary DP projection, private forced padding, proof-search, or quantifier hiding.
